title: Invincible
description: Mark Grayson is a normal teenager except for the fact that his father is the most powerful superhero on the planet. Shortly after his seventeenth birthday, Mark begins to develop powers of his own and enters into his father’s tutelage.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 1x1
episodes_data.description: When Mark Grayson finally inherits powers from his superhero father, it’s a dream come true. But there’s more to being a hero than just choosing a name and costume.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 1x2
episodes_data.description: With his father out of action, Mark struggles to defend the city against an interdimensional invasion, joining forces with a team of teenage superheroes.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 1x3
episodes_data.description: Mark has to cut a study date short to help save Mount Rushmore from a crazed scientist. Robot deals with Action - Comic as he assembles a new team of world-saving superheroes.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 1x4
episodes_data.description: It's two firsts for Mark: a first date and a first trip to another planet. At the same time, Nolan and Debbie revisit their own first vacation together.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 1x5
episodes_data.description: Feeling confident in his new abilities, Mark risks a team-up with a local villain to take down a crime lord, while simultaneously juggling school and a new relationship.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 1x6
episodes_data.description: Mark joins William and Amber on a campus visit to Upstate University, hoping to discover a new future for himself. Debbie makes her own disturbing discovery.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 1x7
episodes_data.description: Feeling lost and confused, Mark looks for advice from Eve. At the same time, everyone's looking for him.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 1x8
episodes_data.description: Mark must prove he's become the hero he's always wanted to be by stopping an unstoppable force.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 2x1
episodes_data.description: In the aftermath of his father's betrayal, Mark struggles with his responsibilities as Invincible and encounters an unexpected enemy.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 2x2
episodes_data.description: It's summer break for Mark and his friends, but supervillains don't take a vacation. Mark is forced to face the consequences of Omni-Man's double life.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 2x3
episodes_data.description: Mark starts his college career, Debbie struggles with personal trauma, and Allen the Alien returns home to find a new threat facing the Coalition of Planets.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 2x4
episodes_data.description: Mark answers the call to save an alien species, but the mission has unexpected personal consequences.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 2x5
episodes_data.description: The Grayson household is upended when Mark returns to Earth with surprising new responsibilities. The Guardians of the Globe face dangers both at home and away.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 2x6
episodes_data.description: After two challenging missions, the Guardians of the Globe struggle to work as a team. Meanwhile, Mark tries to balance his hero duties, personal relationships, and his future as a college student.

episodes_data.title: Invincible 2x7
episodes_data.description: As Mark attempts to salvage his personal life, a new villain arrives, presenting Invincible with his greatest challenge yet. Donald grapples with his past.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 3 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Mark Grayson is back and stronger than ever – with new enemies out for blood and old villains out for revenge.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 3 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Mark takes a stand, unaware of the ramifications for his family, the GDA, and even the Guardians. Cecil remembers his past and Eve makes an important decision.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 3 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Mark struggles to teach Oliver what it means to be a superhero. Debbie explores a new relationship and a changed family dynamic.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 3 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Two strangers ask Mark for help with a mysterious villain. Elsewhere in the galaxy, Nolan grapples with his identity and Allen finds a surprising new ally.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 3 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Mark and Eve start a business and encounter a familiar face. Debbie worries that Oliver's growing up too quickly.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 3 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: A powerful new figure challenges Mark's idea of what's right and what's wrong. Rae approaches Rex with a big life decision.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 3 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Earth's greatest heroes join forces to fight an unimaginable threat.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 3 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: With the world still reeling, a dangerous stranger arrives - testing Mark to his limits and beyond.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 4 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Mark battles enemies new and old in his fight to keep Earth safe.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 4 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Loyalties are challenged when an old enemy is revealed.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 4 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Consequences weigh on Mark. Oliver takes on a new job.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 4 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: Hurm.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 4 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: Mark embarks on a new and dangerous mission, throwing Debbie into a tailspin and plunging Eve into uncertainty.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 4 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Family bonds are put to the test. Under pressure, Allen makes a new friend.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 4 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: Nothing goes according to plan during a massive confrontation.

episodes_data.title: Invincible Season 4 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: Mark confronts his darkest fears as his life changes forever.
